claims.text: The main agent-screen rules lay out the identity header, definition grid, panels and actions, records and tables.
Form controls, fieldset, dialog sizing, focus outline and alert color are styled within the agent screen scope.
Narrow screens collapse the definition grid to one column and the reduced-motion rule disables animation and transition.

decision.rule: Change here when agent screen layout, record tables or dialog sizing needs to change.
decision.failure: Agent records overflow, filters wrap badly, or alerts become unreadable.

questions.q: Where are the agent identity, record and table layout rules defined?
Where should I change the agent dialog sizing and focus styling?
Where can I debug why the agent definition grid breaks on narrow screens?
